passage.label: Ha-Meem; by the clear Book sent down on a blessed night to warn; every precise matter made distinct on that night as a command from Us as mercy from your Lord the Hearing Knowing; Lord of heavens earth and between them if certain; no deity except Him gives life causes death your Lord and Lord of first forefathers; they in doubt amusing themselves; watch for Day sky brings visible smoke covering people painful torment; plea to remove torment claiming belief; how reminder when clear Messenger came then turned away said taught madman; We remove torment little you return disbelief; Day greatest assault take retribution

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Opening letters and oath by the clear Book grounding its descent on a blessed night as warning; every precise matter distinguished on that night as divine command and mercy from the Hearing Knowing Lord of heavens and earth; exclusive deity affirmed through life-giving and death-causing, linked to ancestral lordship; their doubtful amusement answered by the watch-command for the visible-smoke Day bringing painful torment; the belated plea for removal met with the reminder that a clear Messenger had already come and been dismissed as taught and mad; temporary relief promised followed by inevitable return to disbelief; the greatest-assault Day named for retribution

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-assault retribution (16) before the Pharaoh trial narrative opens (17); P2 ends with Israel's election and signs (33); P3 covers the denial-of-resurrection block through the mercy exception (34-42); P4 runs from Zaqqum through the righteous reward and the closing mutual-watch command (43-59).
